name: QuotientGroup.integral_mul_eq_integral_automorphize_mul
statement: Type*} [NormedField K] [NormedSpace ℝ K] [μ.IsMulRightInvariant] {f : G → K} (f_ℒ_1 : Integrable f μ) {g : G ⧸ Γ → K} (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g μ_𝓕) (g_ℒ_infinity : essSup (fun x ↦ ↑‖g x‖ₑ) μ_𝓕 ≠ ∞) (F_ae_measurable : AEStronglyMeasurable (QuotientGroup.automorphize f) μ_𝓕) : ∫ x : G, g (x : G ⧸ Γ) * (f x) ∂μ = ∫ x : G ⧸ Γ, g x * (QuotientGroup.automorphize f x) ∂μ_𝓕

name: QuotientAddGroup.integral_mul_eq_integral_automorphize_mul
